record.issue_text: admin/groups_controller.rb add_members calls params.require(:usernames).split(",") assuming a String, so array-form params raise NoMethodError and return 500 instead of 400

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the code does `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` and then immediately calls `usernames.split(",")`. If the request supplies `usernames` as an Array (e.g. `usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b` or JSON array), `params.require(:usernames)` will return an Array, which does not respond to `split`, causing a `NoMethodError` and a 500. There is no type check/coercion in the diff to prevent this.
